{"reason":"Change the medium/high supplier-switch branch to alert-planner. V1’s 34 switches cost 1.53M; routing all 35 non-low events to premium freight costs 1.225M and guarantees timely arrival, eliminating four stockouts, including the medium 5.3- and 2.8-day failure rows. Cost falls from 2.165M to 1.225M, stockouts fall from 4 to 0, and fitness improves from -2.565 to -1.225.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else
     (list 'monitor))))"}
